updates.content:
Title: Users may experience delays installing Volume Purchase Program (VPP) apps in Microsoft Intune for iOS and Mac

User impact: Users may experience delays installing VPP apps in Microsoft Intune for iOS and Mac.

Current status: We're investigating a potential issue with Microsoft Intune and checking for impact to your organization. We'll provide an update within 30 minutes.

Title: Users may experience delays installing Volume Purchase Program (VPP) apps in Microsoft Intune for iOS and Mac

User impact: Users may experience delays installing VPP apps in Microsoft Intune for iOS and Mac.

More info: Users may see delays in installing VPP apps of up to eight hours.

Current status: We've isolated a recent third-party change, which is resulting in this impact. We're working closely with the third-party to expedite a resolution and will provide an updated remediation timeline as soon as one becomes available.

Scope of impact: This event may impact ay user installing VPP apps in Microsoft Intune for iOS and Mac. This information may be updated as our investigation continues.

Start time: Wednesday, November 11, 2026, at 8:00 AM UTC

Root cause: A recent third-party change is resulting in this impact.

Next update by: Thursday, November 12, 2026, at 8:30 PM UTC

Title: Users may experience delays installing Volume Purchase Program (VPP) apps in Microsoft Intune for iOS and Mac

User impact: Users may have experienced delays installing VPP apps in Microsoft Intune for iOS and Mac.

More info: Users may have seen delays in installing VPP apps of up to eight hours.

Final status: The third-party provided have deployed their fix, and we've confirmed through monitoring service health telemetry that the impact has been remediated.

Scope of impact: This event may have impacted any user installing VPP apps in Microsoft Intune for iOS and Mac. 

Start time: Wednesday, November 11, 2026, at 8:00 AM UTC

End time: Wednesday, November 11, 2026, at 7:30 PM UTC

Root cause: A recent third-party change was resulting in this impact.

Next steps: 
- We're working with the third-party provider to understand what pre-deployment processes can be implemented to avoid their changes to cause impact to VPP apps in the future.

This is the final update for the event.
